title: Product reviews
description: Create and edit reviews for paid orders, and moderate them.

help.title: About Product reviews
help.overview: A product review is a buyer's rating and comment on a product they paid for. It belongs to one paid order and one product on it, and it feeds that product's rating average, rating count, and review count. Marketplace reviews are a separate list.

sections.title: Who can review what
sections.body: A review is tied to a real purchase, not a free-standing comment.
items: Only the order's customer can create the review; it is published under their name.
The order must be paid or partially refunded, and the product must be on it.
One review per product per order. Till sales do not produce reviewable orders here.

sections.title: What can change later
sections.body: The text and the score can change; the link to the purchase cannot.
items: Rating (1 to 5), title, and comment can be edited.
Order and product are fixed once the review exists.
The product's rating average (to one decimal), rating count, and review count are recomputed from live reviews on every create, rating change, delete, and restore.

sections.title: Moderation
items: Only an administrator can delete a review. Deleting is a soft delete; restoring brings the rating back.
A deleted review cannot be restored while a live review exists for the same order and product.
Open the product to see the numbers the shop shows, or the order to see the purchase.
